wind_gust.label: 10-m Wind Gust
wind_gust.note: RTMA wind-gust analysis at the displayed valid time; not an hourly maximum accumulation.

relative_humidity.label: 2-m Relative Humidity
relative_humidity.method: August-Roche-Magnus: 100*exp(17.625*Td/(243.04+Td)-17.625*T/(243.04+T)); T/Td in Celsius; RH relative to liquid water
relative_humidity.note: Calculated from temperature and dewpoint; relative humidity with respect to liquid water, bounded to 0–100%.

heat_index.label: Heat Index
heat_index.method: NWS/WPC Rothfusz regression with low/high humidity adjustments; displayed only when preliminary averaged Steadman HI >=80 F
heat_index.note: Calculated for warm conditions passing the NWS preliminary 80°F heat-index screen. Dark/unshaded areas are outside this index’s range or have missing inputs. Assumes shade/light wind.

wind_chill.label: Wind Chill
wind_chill.note: Calculated only at temperatures ≤50°F and sustained winds >3 mph. Dark/unshaded areas are outside this index’s range or have missing inputs; gusts are not used.

mslp.label: Barometric Pressure (MSLP)
mslp.note: Pressure reduced to mean sea level to compare the weather pattern across elevations. HRRR background uses MAPS sea-level reduction, with smooth corrections from quality-checked METAR reported MSLP. Station points remain actual reports.

feature_filter.support_rule: one interior + two exterior METAR reports; 0.2 hPa contrast; 150 km
